relevance_note: The paper reports a family in which the proband and his father carry a TNFAIP3 deletion: "拷贝数变异分析发现先证者及其父亲存在TNFAIP3外显子2~9杂合缺失".
method_note: Read the whole Chinese-language paper manually; output assembled with a short Python script whose values were all typed from my reading, then every span was checked verbatim by script. First-hand people: proband Ⅲ-4 and father Ⅱ-4 (both carriers of TNFAIP3 exon 2~9 heterozygous deletion, CNV found by WES CNV analysis, confirmed by qPCR; qPCR is CNV confirmation, not recorded as functional evidence). The proband's other parent ('父母'; the paper never says '母亲' for her) was sequenced too and is not named as a carrier; recorded as 'parent of Ⅲ-4' with no variant row and nothing else reported (carrier status negative only by implication). Other family members are described only as a group ('家系中其他成员无发热、腹泻、腹痛、口腔溃疡、关节炎等临床表现，但未进行基因检测') with no individual detail and the pedigree figure is not in the text, so they get no rows. Literature persons from the Discussion with individual-level facts were included: ref ［7］ patient (adult onset, one of 19 CNV cases; no variant printed), ref ［6］ patient (same variant as this family; variant string taken from the family's variant via '具有相同变异'; zygosity/pathogenicity left not reported under D-29), ref ［9］ girl and her carrier mother (c.1300_1301delinsTA（p.A434*）), and two brothers from the Japanese survey ref ［20］ (no variant printed, so no variant rows). Supplementary Table 1 (附表1, 19 CNV cases) is not included in the file; its patients are only summarised as counts and get no rows. Group counts (e.g. 发热 14/19) excluded no one. Contradiction/oddities: ref ［9］ is cited among the CNV references ［6-19］ yet the text gives that patient a nonsense variant, so no CNV type was assigned to ref ［9］. Father: endoscopy says '慢性非萎缩性胃炎' but pathology says '轻度慢性萎缩性胃炎'; both recorded as observed (different methods). Proband had a history of recurrent oral ulcers but '口腔黏膜未见溃疡' at admission, and colorectal ulcers at diagnosis but none at follow-up colonoscopy; these were treated as time-point findings (excluded rows with timing in detail, no HPO ID), not contradictions, and the checklist items stay observed. Proband age_at_last_evaluation '3岁4个月' is his age at admission (2024-01-11) as the paper reports him; he was then followed 1.5 years with no later age printed. Father's ESR 28, CRP 9.67 and fecal calprotectin 176 have no normal range or abnormality statement for him, so not recorded as features. Normal examinations as a whole (心肺听诊正常, 腹部触诊正常, 肝胆胰脾超声未见异常, 肝肾功能正常, infection screen negative) were recorded as written, excluding nothing more specific. 'No rash' and 'superficial lymph nodes not enlarged' did not exclude the composite checklist items (narrow vs broad rule). Ref ［6］ fever is not stated as recurrent, so 'recurrent fever' is not reported for that patient; ref ［20］ older brother's '严重神经系统症状' is not specified as CNS, so CNS checklist left not reported. The anti-infliximab antibody is a drug antibody and was not counted as an autoantibody. No tables or stacked cells in this paper.
